messages:
maya: Heads-up — planning session for DevEx roadmap focused on SDK quickstarts + sample apps. Need to align on launch criteria, scope tradeoffs, and customer asks. Target: finalize by EOD Friday. cc @kevin @jenna

sam: I can carve out 4 hours Thu but heads-down on infra this sprint.

jenna: We should define parity checklist across languages. Current gap: Node + Python parity is missing docs and streaming examples, Rust is experimental so my vote is to ship it later.

kevin: Customer ask: single-click deploy sample for Dedicated customers. UX constraint: cannot require prod creds or expose keys. Should be runnable against a sandbox.

liam: Proposed minimal scope for launch: 1) Node quickstart + demo app, 2) Python sample app showing streaming + error handling, 3) Dedicated deploy template (Terraform + dev instructions), 4) three tiny tutorials (auth, batching, cost tuning).

maya: Proposed launch criteria: a) CI + lint passing on samples, b) two customer-ready samples (Node, Python), c) clear README + 1-liner "what this sample shows", d) one recorded demo and a short playbook for support.

sam: Technical blockers: we need a sandbox for Dedicated deploy tests. Today we only have prod infra. I can prototype ephemeral infra but need billing exemption or a test account.

anna: Filing a billing exemption ticket now (IT-1297). Can also provision ephemeral test projects for the team — will update in the ticket.

jenna: Docs items checklist: runnable commands, minimal Dockerfile, config snippet for streaming. Example snippet to include in quickstarts:

```
npx @redwood/infer quickstart --model redwood-v1 --runtime node
# or
python -m redwood_infer.quickstart --model redwood-v1
```

liam: Enterprise ask: include telemetry opt-in flow and KMS/keys guidance for Private deploys. Also add a short caveat about cost and quota.

maya: Decision proposal: ship Node + Python now, defer Rust and extended languages to next quarter. Vote?

kevin: :thumbsup: ship Node+Python only. PMM will prepare launch copy and customer-facing checklist.

sam: I'll own the Node quickstart implementation + CI. @jenna you take Python? Target: Thu-Fri to get initial PRs.

jenna: Yes, taking Python. Will add streaming example and the docs checklist. Ping infra once Anna confirms.

deploy-bot: Reminder: weekly roadmap sync Thu 10:00am — meeting created: https://calendar/roadmap-sync-Thu

maya: Great — I'll update the roadmap doc (link incoming) and drop the launch checklist in #devex-playbooks. Leaving notes here for handoff. Thanks all.
